My Rill cartridge froze on a trip. Is it safe to keep using, and will the warranty pay for a new one?
rows.answer: Yes, it is safe to keep using the cartridge [1]. The warranty covers faults in material and workmanship, not damage caused by freezing [2]. The warranty does not cover normal wear, accidents, or damage caused by freezing [2]. To make a claim, send photographs and the order number to the repairs team [2].
